```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

## 1. Load Data

```{r}
INPUT_FILE <- "Raw Data New/december.csv"
OUTPUT_FILE <- "Cleaned Data/december_cleaned.csv"

TARGET_YEAR <- "2025"
TARGET_MONTH <- "12"

df <- read.csv(
  INPUT_FILE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  colClasses = "character",
  na.strings = c("", "NA")
)

cat("Original dataset\n")
cat("Rows:", nrow(df), "\n")
cat("Columns:", ncol(df), "\n")

cat("\nColumn names:\n")
print(names(df))

cat("\nFirst 5 rows:\n")
print(head(df, 5))

cat("\nOriginal flight dates:\n")
print(head(df$FL_DATE, 10))

cat("\nData structure:\n")
str(df)
```

## 2. Check Required Columns

```{r}
required_columns <- c(
  "FL_DATE",
  "OP_UNIQUE_CARRIER",
  "OP_CARRIER_FL_NUM",
  "ORIGIN_AIRPORT_ID",
  "ORIGIN",
  "DEST_AIRPORT_ID",
  "DEST",
  "CRS_DEP_TIME",
  "CRS_ARR_TIME",
  "ARR_DELAY",
  "CANCELLED",
  "DIVERTED",
  "CRS_ELAPSED_TIME",
  "DISTANCE"
)

missing_columns <- setdiff(
  required_columns,
  names(df)
)

if (length(missing_columns) > 0) {
  stop(
    paste(
      "Missing required columns:",
      paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", ")
    )
  )
}

cat("All required columns are available.\n")
```

## 3. Check and Remove Empty Columns

```{r}
if ("CANCELLATION_CODE" %in% names(df)) {

  cancellation_values <- trimws(
    df$CANCELLATION_CODE
  )

  if (all(
    is.na(cancellation_values) |
    cancellation_values == ""
  )) {

    df$CANCELLATION_CODE <- NULL

    cat(
      "CANCELLATION_CODE removed because all values are empty or NA.\n"
    )

  } else {

    cat(
      "CANCELLATION_CODE retained because it contains valid values.\n"
    )

  }

}

cat("\nColumns after checking empty columns:\n")
print(names(df))
```

## 4. Remove Duplicates

```{r}
duplicate_count <- sum(duplicated(df))

df <- df[!duplicated(df), ]

cat("Duplicate rows removed:", duplicate_count, "\n")
cat("Rows remaining:", nrow(df), "\n")
```

## 5. Convert Data Types

```{r}
cat("FL_DATE before conversion:\n")
print(head(df$FL_DATE, 5))

cat("\nData type before conversion:\n")
print(class(df$FL_DATE))


# Convert FL_DATE to ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD)

date_values <- trimws(df$FL_DATE)

date_values <- sub(
  "\\s+.*$",
  "",
  date_values
)

parsed_dates <- as.Date(
  date_values,
  format = "%m/%d/%Y"
)

iso_dates <- as.Date(
  date_values,
  format = "%Y-%m-%d"
)

parsed_dates[is.na(parsed_dates)] <-
  iso_dates[is.na(parsed_dates)]

if (any(is.na(parsed_dates))) {
  stop("Some flight dates could not be converted.")
}

df$FL_DATE <- parsed_dates


# Convert numeric columns

numeric_columns <- c(
  "ORIGIN_AIRPORT_ID",
  "DEST_AIRPORT_ID",
  "CRS_DEP_TIME",
  "CRS_ARR_TIME",
  "ARR_DELAY",
  "CANCELLED",
  "DIVERTED",
  "CRS_ELAPSED_TIME",
  "DISTANCE"
)

optional_numeric_columns <- c(
  "YEAR",
  "QUARTER",
  "MONTH",
  "DAY_OF_MONTH",
  "DAY_OF_WEEK",
  "OP_CARRIER_AIRLINE_ID"
)

numeric_columns <- c(
  numeric_columns,
  intersect(optional_numeric_columns, names(df))
)

for (column in numeric_columns) {

  original_values <- df[[column]]

  converted_values <- suppressWarnings(
    as.numeric(original_values)
  )

  conversion_errors <- !is.na(original_values) &
    is.na(converted_values)

  if (any(conversion_errors)) {
    stop(
      paste(
        "Invalid numeric values found in column:",
        column
      )
    )
  }

  df[[column]] <- converted_values
}


# Keep flight number as character

df$OP_CARRIER_FL_NUM <- as.character(
  df$OP_CARRIER_FL_NUM
)


cat("\nData types after conversion:\n")
str(df)

cat("\nConverted flight dates:\n")
print(head(df$FL_DATE, 5))

cat("\nFL_DATE data type:\n")
print(class(df$FL_DATE))
```

## 6. Check Date Range

```{r}
cat("Date range\n")

if (nrow(df) == 0) {
  stop("The dataset is empty.")
}

cat(
  "Earliest date:",
  format(min(df$FL_DATE), "%Y-%m-%d"),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Latest date:",
  format(max(df$FL_DATE), "%Y-%m-%d"),
  "\n"
)

cat("\nFlights by year:\n")
print(table(format(df$FL_DATE, "%Y")))

cat("\nFlights by month:\n")
print(table(format(df$FL_DATE, "%m")))


if (any(format(df$FL_DATE, "%Y") != TARGET_YEAR)) {
  stop("The dataset contains dates outside the selected year.")
}

if (any(format(df$FL_DATE, "%m") != TARGET_MONTH)) {
  stop("The dataset contains flights outside the selected month.")
}

cat("\nDate validation successful.\n")
```

## 7. Filter Selected Origin Airports

```{r}
airports <- c("ATL", "ORD", "DFW", "DEN", "JFK")

df <- df[df$ORIGIN %in% airports, ]

cat("Selected origin airports:\n")
print(airports)

cat("\nFlights by origin airport:\n")
print(table(df$ORIGIN))

cat("\nRows after airport filtering:", nrow(df), "\n")
```

## 8. Check Cancelled and Diverted Flights

```{r}
cancelled_count <- sum(
  df$CANCELLED == 1,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

diverted_count <- sum(
  df$DIVERTED == 1,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

cat("Cancelled flights:", cancelled_count, "\n")
cat("Diverted flights:", diverted_count, "\n")

cat("\nCancelled flights by origin:\n")
print(table(df$ORIGIN[df$CANCELLED == 1]))

cat("\nDiverted flights by origin:\n")
print(table(df$ORIGIN[df$DIVERTED == 1]))
```

## 9. Remove Cancelled and Diverted Flights

```{r}
df <- df[
  !is.na(df$CANCELLED) &
  !is.na(df$DIVERTED) &
  df$CANCELLED == 0 &
  df$DIVERTED == 0,
]

cat(
  "Rows after removing cancelled and diverted flights:",
  nrow(df),
  "\n"
)
```

## 10. Remove Missing Arrival Delay

```{r}
missing_arr_delay <- sum(is.na(df$ARR_DELAY))

df <- df[!is.na(df$ARR_DELAY), ]

cat("Missing arrival delays removed:", missing_arr_delay, "\n")
cat("Rows remaining:", nrow(df), "\n")
```

## 11. Create Target Variables

```{r}
df$major_delay_30 <- as.integer(df$ARR_DELAY >= 30)

df$major_delay_60 <- as.integer(df$ARR_DELAY >= 60)

cat("Major delay >= 30 minutes:\n")
print(table(df$major_delay_30))

cat("\nMajor delay >= 60 minutes:\n")
print(table(df$major_delay_60))
```

## 12. Create Date Features

```{r}
df$month <- as.integer(format(df$FL_DATE, "%m"))

df$day_of_week <- as.integer(
  format(df$FL_DATE, "%u")
) - 1

df$day_of_month <- as.integer(
  format(df$FL_DATE, "%d")
)

cat("Date features created.\n")

print(
  head(df[, c(
    "FL_DATE",
    "month",
    "day_of_week",
    "day_of_month"
  )])
)
```

## 13. Create Scheduled Time Features

```{r}
hhmm_to_minutes <- function(value) {

  if (is.na(value)) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  value <- as.integer(value)

  if (value == 2400) {
    return(0)
  }

  hour <- value %/% 100
  minute <- value %% 100

  if (hour > 23 || minute > 59) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  return(hour * 60 + minute)
}


df$scheduled_departure_minutes <- sapply(
  df$CRS_DEP_TIME,
  hhmm_to_minutes
)

df$scheduled_arrival_minutes <- sapply(
  df$CRS_ARR_TIME,
  hhmm_to_minutes
)

df$scheduled_departure_hour <- floor(
  df$scheduled_departure_minutes / 60
)

df$scheduled_arrival_hour <- floor(
  df$scheduled_arrival_minutes / 60
)


cat("Scheduled time features created.\n")

print(
  head(df[, c(
    "CRS_DEP_TIME",
    "CRS_ARR_TIME",
    "scheduled_departure_minutes",
    "scheduled_arrival_minutes",
    "scheduled_departure_hour",
    "scheduled_arrival_hour"
  )])
)
```

## 14. Check Invalid Scheduled Times

```{r}
invalid_departure_count <- sum(
  is.na(df$scheduled_departure_minutes)
)

invalid_arrival_count <- sum(
  is.na(df$scheduled_arrival_minutes)
)

cat(
  "Invalid departure times:",
  invalid_departure_count,
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Invalid arrival times:",
  invalid_arrival_count,
  "\n"
)
```

## 15. Check Missing Values

```{r}
missing_values <- colSums(is.na(df))

print(missing_values)

cat(
  "\nTotal missing values:",
  sum(missing_values),
  "\n"
)

cat("\nColumns with missing values:\n")
print(missing_values[missing_values > 0])
```

```{r}
cat("Final dataset\n")

cat("Rows:", nrow(df), "\n")
cat("Columns:", ncol(df), "\n")

cat("\nFlights by origin airport:\n")
print(table(df$ORIGIN))

cat("\nFlights by airline:\n")
print(table(df$OP_UNIQUE_CARRIER))

cat("\nFirst 5 rows:\n")
print(head(df, 5))
```

## 17. Summary Statistics

```{r}
cat("Arrival delay statistics:\n")
print(summary(df$ARR_DELAY))

cat("\nMajor delay >= 30 minutes:\n")
print(table(df$major_delay_30))

cat("\nMajor delay >= 60 minutes:\n")
print(table(df$major_delay_60))

cat("\nDistance statistics:\n")

```

## 18. Save Cleaned Dataset

```{r}
if (!dir.exists("Cleaned Data")) {
  dir.create("Cleaned Data")
}

write.csv(
  df,
  OUTPUT_FILE,
  row.names = FALSE
)

cat("Preprocessing completed.\n")
cat("Output file:", OUTPUT_FILE, "\n")
cat("Final rows:", nrow(df), "\n")
cat("Final columns:", ncol(df), "\n")
cat("File saved successfully.\n")
```
